blockers: An action gives no visible feedback near the control.
fixes: Show a pressed or selected state at once, and confirm the result near the control.
Show the state of each item inline with an icon, a label, or a count.
Give the control a visible pressed or selected state.
In empty states, say what will appear and why, and offer one action.
Set code, commands, IDs, and paths in one monospace font.
Use status labels that a new user understands.
